title: Services
description: Specimen and lab transport, hospital and sterile processing runs, pharmacy delivery, clinic and dental delivery, and legal and financial documents — 24/7, including holidays.
heading: Medical first. Business deliveries with the same care.
lead: Premier Courier Services is the trusted medical and business courier for Central and Northern Arizona — on time, every time, 24/7, including holidays.
